about: The Grimoire: MILO’s commands as spells (LORE.md §11; PLAN.md §10; CONTRACT-PHASE4.md §7.6, §9.11). Names are LORE §21’s Spells. words are the plain words that cast a spell from the Log’s command bar; intent names what a Phase 4 spell does there, and every other spell answers that it arrives with its from. Fight spells and knacks live apart, in content/combat/spells.json.

spells.name: Kindle
spells.flavour: The first spell every Lanternkeeper learns, and the last one they forget.

spells.name: Wayfinding
spells.flavour: Milo knows the way. He usually knows a shortcut.

spells.name: Build Plan
spells.flavour: Tell the ground what it’s for.

spells.name: Evening Bell

spells.name: Gathering Echoes

spells.name: Memory Knot
spells.flavour: Tie it off so it doesn’t unravel.
